opening_log: First real choice tonight. River trader at Bend do Sapo. Coded voice on an unregistered band. River is not guerrilla — remember that.

thoughts.bend_protected: You kept a bend off the military net. Someone may remember.
thoughts.bend_exposed: HQ has the grid. The trader band went silent.

bend_strangers.title: Bend do Sapo
bend_strangers.body: Strangers near the bend. River trader says not military. Survey maps, wrong questions.

coded_window.title: Coded window
coded_window.body: After midnight. Not the posted list. Someone knows I'm the new voice.

day_close: Night three. You served someone tonight — maybe more than one.
